basic_details.job_title: District Educational Officer, Jangaon Guest Special Needs Educator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 14 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Educational Officer's Office, Jangaon District (Zilla Vidyashakhadhikari Karyalayam, Jangaon Zilla), Telangana, is filling 14 Guest Special Needs Educator posts in PM SHRI High Schools of the district on a purely temporary basis for five months, November 2026 to March 2027. Applications must be submitted at the District Educational Officer's Office, Jangaon District, during office hours, by 27 November 2026; applications received after this deadline will not be considered. The test is on 29 November 2026 at 11.00 AM.

content_sections.heading: About DEO Jangaon Guest Special Needs Educators
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the District Educational Officer, Jangaon District, signed by Sandeep Kumar Jha, I.A.S., and dated 20 November 2026. The Guest Special Needs Educators will work with Children with Special Needs (CwSN) in PM SHRI High Schools and Bhavitha Centres under Samagra Shiksha. The recruitment process is subject to the instructions and guidelines issued by the State Project Director, Samagra Shiksha, Telangana.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed application format, with self-attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures, at this place: District Educational Officer's Office, Jangaon District (during office hours) The last date for submission is 27 November 2026. Applications received after the fixed deadline and incomplete applications will not be considered. The notice does not attach the application format or say where it can be obtained; for more details, candidates may contact the District Educational Officer's Office, Jangaon District, during office working hours.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 14 posts are for Guest Special Needs Educators in PM SHRI Schools, with a monthly honorarium of Rs.16,500/- (Sixteen thousand five hundred rupees only). Candidates must hold any one of the following qualifications: Degree with B.Ed. (Special Education), or B.Ed. (General) with a one-year diploma in Special Education, or B.Ed. (General) with a two-year diploma in Special Education, or B.Ed. (General) with Post Graduate Professional Diploma in Special Education (PGPD), or B.Ed. Special Education and Post Graduate Professional Certificate in Special Education (PGPC), or PG Diploma in Special Education (Mental Retardation), or PG Diploma in Special Education (Multiple Disability: Physical & Neurological), or PG Diploma in Special Education (Loco motor Impairment and Cerebral Palsy), or Secondary Level Teacher Training Course in Visual Impairment, or Senior Diploma in Teaching the Deaf, or B.A. B.Ed. in Visual Impairment. Candidates must possess all the prescribed eligibility conditions and educational qualifications. An RCI Registration certificate, as applicable under the rules, is among the documents to enclose. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Eligible local candidates will be given the opportunity based on merit, the available vacancies and suitable eligibility, in this order of preference: Candidates belonging to the concerned village. Candidates belonging to the concerned mandal. Candidates belonging to Jangaon district. Among eligible candidates, additional preference may be given to those with experience in the relevant field. Monthly honorarium: Rs.16,500/-. Tenure: five months (November 2026 to March 2027). The appointment is purely temporary and on a short-term basis. The appointment ends automatically on completion of the fixed tenure. The appointment gives no right or claim to a government job or regularisation in future. For the full eligibility of the post, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: DEO Jangaon Guest Special Needs Educators Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Guest Special Needs Educators will have to perform these duties and responsibilities: Identify Children with Special Needs (CwSN) and assess their needs. Provide special educational support and the necessary teaching interventions. Support the school enrolment, retention and educational progress of children with special needs. Coordinate with IERPs, Mandal Educational Officers and Headmasters. Bring the services of Bhavitha Centres within reach of the children. Conduct school visits, home visits and follow-up monitoring programmes, and maintain the prescribed records. Perform other duties related to Samagra Shiksha assigned by the concerned officials.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following documents must be attached to the application: Educational qualification certificates. Professional qualification certificates in Special Education. RCI Registration certificate, as applicable under the rules. Relevant experience certificates (if any). Local residence certificate / certificate proving the relevant locality. Aadhaar card or other prescribed identity proof. Recent passport size photo.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice fixes a test for the posts on 29 November 2026 at 11.00 AM at IDOC Complex, Ground Floor, Main Conference Hall, Jangaon. The notice does not describe the subjects or pattern of the test. Candidates will be given the opportunity based on merit, the available vacancies and suitable eligibility, with the village, mandal and district preference order given above and additional preference that may be given for relevant experience. The District Educational Officer, Jangaon has the right to verify the certificates and eligibility of candidates.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary for five months only. Selected candidates must work in the allotted PM SHRI schools and also provide services in the allotted Bhavitha Centres as needed. Keeping the needs of children with special needs in view, the services of selected Guest Special Needs Educators may be used within the allotted PM SHRI schools, clusters or mandals. The decision of the competent authority on the recruitment process is final.

faq.question: Q1. How many Guest Special Needs Educator vacancies are there in Jangaon?
faq.answer: There are 14 Guest Special Needs Educator posts in PM SHRI High Schools of Jangaon district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 27 November 2026; applications received after this deadline will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: Candidates need any one of 11 listed qualifications, such as a degree with B.Ed. (Special Education), B.Ed. (General) with a one-year or two-year diploma in Special Education, a PG Diploma in Special Education, Senior Diploma in Teaching the Deaf, or B.A. B.Ed. in Visual Impairment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a Guest Special Needs Educator in Jangaon?
faq.answer: The monthly honorarium is Rs.16,500/- (Sixteen thousand five hundred rupees only).

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application in the prescribed format, with self-attested copies of the listed documents, at the District Educational Officer's Office, Jangaon District, during office hours, by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. When and where is the test?
faq.answer: The test is on 29 November 2026 at 11.00 AM at IDOC Complex, Ground Floor, Main Conference Hall, Jangaon.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary for five months, November 2026 to March 2027, ends automatically after the tenure, and gives no claim to a government job or regularisation.

faq.question: Q8. Who gets preference in the selection?
faq.answer: Candidates from the concerned village get first preference, then the concerned mandal, then Jangaon district; additional preference may be given for experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of educational and Special Education professional certificates, RCI Registration certificate as applicable, experience certificates (if any), local residence certificate, Aadhaar or other prescribed ID, and a recent passport size photo.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates work?
faq.answer: They will work in the allotted PM SHRI schools and also serve in allotted Bhavitha Centres as needed; their services may be used within the allotted schools, clusters or mandals.
